text:
Hillsboro had 4 licensed child care facilities in 2025
In 2025, Hillsboro had 4 licensed child care facilities, the Illinois Department of Children and Family Services reports.
Among these, 1 facility was a day care center (25%) while 3 were group day care homes (75%).
Most providers in Hillsboro serve children from birth to 12 years and 6 weeks to 6 years.
All Hillsboro child care facilities offer services in English.
Across Illinois, there were 8,602 licensed child care facilities in 2025.
The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services has frozen certain federal child care and family assistance grants for California, Colorado, Minnesota, New York and Illinois because of fraud and misuse concerns, according to a Jan. 6 announcement from the agency. Nearly $2.4 billion in Child Care and Development Fund grants, $7.35 billion in Temporary Assistance for Needy Families funds, and $869 million in Social Services Block Grants are on hold, and states must now provide documentation before payments continue.
Gov. J.B. Pritzker of Illinois called the freeze “wrong and cruel” and said Illinois could challenge the decision, noting that the state already maintains anti-fraud measures.
The state’s administration estimates that the freeze could impact about 100,000 families and more than 152,000 children served by the Child Care Assistance Program in Illinois, in addition to funding for thousands of licensed care providers and 275 human service organizations.
